And there's a lot of English groups come and play in the list so that was quite interesting for us as well.
For me there's no question of moving here. We could never do a decent social life around work.
I run the customer service department for Soft and Cold Credit, called Consumer Finance, which is basically six call centres around France.
A very good catcher in area for recruitment, for recruiting staff. We're very well connected to the rest of France.
